[FMLA 03] HeronFormula — Heron's Formula

Triangle area from three side lengths.

Calculator scroll name: HeronFormula. Triangle area from three side lengths.

formula
Area=s(s−a)(s−b)(s−c)​
s=2a+b+c​

If you only have the three side lengths (no angle), Heron still gives the area. The picture is that filled-in triangle.

keys
FMLA→0→3

Primary inputs: a, b, c.

steps

How to run

  1. Press FMLA, then 0, then 3 (or scroll to the name and EXE)
  2. Enter each prompted value
  3. Read the result

Example

a = 3, b = 4, c = 5
s = (3+4+5)/2 = 6
Area = 6(6−3)(6−4)(6−5)​ = 36​ = 6
note

Sides must satisfy a+b>c, b+c>a, and c+a>b (all > 0). Otherwise the area is not defined and the routine errors.
